text:
𝟭𝟳𝟱* 𝗙𝗥𝗢𝗠 𝟭𝟳/𝟱 🔥

Kapil Dev, Tunbridge Wells, 18 June 1983: 175* off 138 balls vs Zimbabwe.
India were 17/5 when he walked in. They finished on 266/8 and won. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #KapilDev
